prior_back_to_back_validation.method: Athlete-confirmed direct back-to-back testing on the same Enduro platform after custom damper tuning.
prior_back_to_back_validation.result: The setups felt subtly different but immediately interchangeable. The coil had the preferred response and speed on DH lines; the air shock had subtly better pumping support.

rear_shock_setup.comparison_guardrail: Custom damper tuning and prior athlete back-to-back testing establish closely matched complete chassis behavior and functional interchangeability. The air and coil springs still retain subtle spring-specific behavior, so race selection remains course-specific rather than mechanically identical. External click numbers are preserved but not assumed directly equivalent across the two shocks.

coach_contract_audit.action_alignment_notes: The activity retained the Enduro, clipless pedals, two climbs, climb RPE 4/4 and a two-descent ceiling. It did not execute the nominal matched action: the coil was replaced by the air shock, Pure Quill used deliberately mixed intent and waiting, and the second prescribed Pure Quill cycle was replaced by Flintstone novelty. The explicit not-triggered stop outcome is preserved separately and does not restore action alignment.
coach_contract_audit.load_alignment: Garmin load 169.6 was below the immutable contract expectation of 230 and below its 190-270 range. Because setup, route, speed intent and stop structure changed materially, this is execution-changed input rather than a nominal model miss.
coach_contract_audit.calibration_disposition: Ineligible for physiology-only nominal matching and ineligible for true digital-twin calibration. It must not enter the matched Pure Quill route-repeat load prior or earn the two-cycle Pure Quill progression gate.
coach_contract_audit.progression_credit: Credit one meaningful MTB exposure, two RPE-4 self-pedaled climbs, one mixed-intent Pure Quill descent, one controlled Flintstone re-entry and successful current-session confirmation of an established air-shock race option. Do not unlock a third Pure Quill cycle from this session.

suspension_interpretation.verdict: Both shocks are validated race options. Today's air-shock ride was a successful current-state revalidation, not the first proof of an untested setup and not a same-day air-versus-coil comparison.
suspension_interpretation.primary_rider_adaptation: Strong cognition and body state, accurate braking and line choice, and successful Flintstone re-familiarization produced the clean technical result. Less-relaxed hands on rough Flintstone are the clearest current rider constraint.
suspension_interpretation.secondary_setup_effect: The air shock supplied adequate mid-stroke support and controlled successive impacts without wallow, bottom-out, pack-down, kick or pitch. Lower unloaded traction and a slightly lower seated ride-height feel may reflect the air spring, the dry surface, rider loading, or an imprecise sag estimate; the mixed session cannot separate them.
suspension_interpretation.validation_constraint: A new equivalence test is not required before every swap. Choose coil for DH-dominant roughness and rear tracking, or air for pumpy/pedally stages and lower weight, then complete one course-specific shakedown with the selected setup fixed. Reconsider only for repeated skitter, pedal strikes, wallow, bottom-out, pack-down, kick, pitch, excess arm pump or worse final-stage precision.
